# Chapter 3: The Envoy of the Silver Guild

At dusk, someone knocked on the tower door.

The envoy of the Silver Guild stood outside.

The envoy bowed politely and held out a letter.

The old man read the letter without changing his expression.

"The guild always arrives far too late."

The envoy flushed and could not go on.

Erian quietly poured tea between the two of them.

As the night deepened, the tower's bell rang by itself.
